citations.claim: Flam. Liq. 2 must include prevention statements P210, P211, P235, P242, P243; at minimum P211

citations.claim: Product identifier must be the exact name used consistently
citations.evidence: Art. 17(1)(c) only refers to 'product identifiers as specified in Article 18'; consistency with the SDS is Art. 18(1). 'Example solvent' satisfies Art. 18(3)(a) 'the trade name or the designation of the mixture'.

citations.claim: EUH066 supplemental statement must be included where listed
citations.evidence: Annex IV is the list of precautionary statements. EUH066 is assigned by Annex II 1.2.4 and worded per Annex III Part 2 (Art. 25(1)).

citations.claim: Pictograms must be >= 10 mm
citations.evidence: Art. 18(3) is the product identifier for a mixture. Pictogram size is Annex I 1.2.1.4 Table 1.3, which for >3 L to 50 L requires 'At least 23 x 23' (10 x 10 is the <=3 L floor).

citations.claim: Must use only 'Danger' (not 'Danger Warning')
citations.evidence: Art. 17(1)(e) only lists 'where applicable, signal words in accordance with Article 20'. The rule is Art. 20(3): "Where the signal word 'Danger' is used on the label, the signal word 'Warning' shall not appear on the label."

otherClaims.quote: Annex IV Table 6.2: P211 is for 'Aerosols (section 2.3)'; label already has P210, P233, P240
